hyperedges.label: Delhi Six Couture Tracking Stack
hyperedges.rationale: GA4, Meta Pixel, and CAPI form the complete tracking stack for Delhi Six Couture, all verified live per SESSION-CONTEXT.md. Together they enable conversion tracking, audience building, and server-side deduplication for Meta ads.

hyperedges.label: Integrated Ad Campaign Strategy Documents
hyperedges.rationale: These three documents collectively define the paid advertising strategy for Delhi Six Couture: the 30-day sprint plan, the 20K budget viability and phase structure, and the Meta vs Google platform rationale. All three cross-reference each other and converge on Meta-first lead generation.

hyperedges.label: Frontend UI UX Code Improvement Documents
hyperedges.rationale: IMPROVEMENTS_SUMMARY.md, CODE_CHANGES.md, and TESTING_GUIDE.md together document the same set of frontend improvements to App.js and styles.css: improvements summary provides intent and overview, code changes shows exact before/after diffs, and testing guide provides verification steps for the same set of changes.

hyperedges.label: Delhi Six Couture Tracking Stack
hyperedges.rationale: GA4, Meta Pixel, and CAPI form the complete tracking stack for Delhi Six Couture, all verified live per SESSION-CONTEXT.md. Together they enable conversion tracking, audience building, and server-side deduplication for Meta ads.

hyperedges.label: Integrated Ad Campaign Strategy Documents
hyperedges.rationale: These three documents collectively define the paid advertising strategy for Delhi Six Couture: the 30-day sprint plan, the 20K budget viability and phase structure, and the Meta vs Google platform rationale. All three cross-reference each other and converge on Meta-first lead generation.

hyperedges.label: Frontend UI UX Code Improvement Documents
hyperedges.rationale: IMPROVEMENTS_SUMMARY.md, CODE_CHANGES.md, and TESTING_GUIDE.md together document the same set of frontend improvements to App.js and styles.css: improvements summary provides intent and overview, code changes shows exact before/after diffs, and testing guide provides verification steps for the same set of changes.
